adjudication.rationale: The diff does implement a staff throttle bypass: `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` passes `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)` to `TopicRetriever` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb), and `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` returns `false` immediately when `@opts[:no_throttle]` is set (lib/topic_retriever.rb). When an embed isn’t found, `EmbedController#best` enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading`, whose JS reloads the page every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb). On each reload, a staff user would enqueue another job that can run `Jobs::PollFeed` (full feed download via `open(...)`) and then `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (remote page fetch via `open(url)`) without the 60s Redis throttle. This is a real, diff-grounded performance/resource-usage concern, though not a correctness defect per se.
